input.diff_summary: Adds incidents match block to firestore.rules at the same nesting level as vets/petVets/vetKeys (user-scoped, not pet-scoped per §D7). Adds 2 rules-test cases (alice owns, alice cannot access bob).

notes: Cold-reader correctly recognized: (a) the §D7 design explicitly defers document-level invariants (BR-13/16/28/29) and petId validity to the client, so absence of server-side field validation is in-scope by design and not a finding; (b) test paths use users/alice/incidents/incident1 matching the user-scoped (not pet-scoped) layout in §D7. Notable: this is the cold-reader's first encounter with a rules-test diff (precedent file: src/tests/firestore.rules.test.ts) and it correctly traversed the alice-vs-bob assertion pattern without drifting into 'I'd have used helper X' style commentary.
